meta.title: Freedom Store
hero.headline: Uninstall_1984
values.1.title: Open Source
values.1.text: Every app in Freedom Store is vetted for privacy, security and censorship resistance.
values.2.title: Moving against oppression
values.2.text: You're not just downloading apps, you're adding your voice to a global movement pushing back against digital authoritarianism.
values.3.title: Digital sovereignty restored
values.3.text: Freedom Store returns control of your device to where it belongs - with you. Install what you want, when you want it.
